activation_failed.meaning: The new release was staged but could not be switched to active.
activation_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

activation_stage_failed.meaning: The staged release could not be moved into place.
activation_stage_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

active_controller_invalid.meaning: The active kanban MCP release does not match its pin or does not start.
active_controller_invalid.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

applied.meaning: The selected aicoding release is active.

apt_install_failed.meaning: Installing system packages with apt failed.
apt_install_failed.fix: Run `sudo apt-get update` and check for errors, then `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

apt_lock_busy.meaning: Another apt or dpkg process held the package lock.
apt_lock_busy.fix: Usually clears on the next pass. Otherwise wait for the other apt run and run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

apt_unavailable.meaning: `apt-get` is not available on this system.
apt_unavailable.fix: Install the listed system tools with your package manager.

archive_download_failed.fix: Check network access to the download source, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`. Details are in `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

archive_invalid.meaning: The downloaded Cursor archive could not be extracted.
archive_invalid.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

browser_install_failed.meaning: Downloading the Playwright Chromium browser failed.
browser_install_failed.fix: Check network access to the download source, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`. Details are in `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

browser_marker_commit_failed.meaning: The marker for the installed Playwright browser could not be written.
browser_marker_commit_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

browser_ready.meaning: The Playwright Chromium browser is installed and runs.

browser_ready_version_unavailable.meaning: The Playwright browser is present but its version is unknown.
browser_ready_version_unavailable.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

browser_stage_cleanup_failed.meaning: A leftover Playwright browser stage could not be removed.
browser_stage_cleanup_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

browser_stage_prepare_failed.meaning: The Playwright browser staging directory could not be created.
browser_stage_prepare_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

browser_unavailable.meaning: No Playwright Chromium browser is installed.

browser_validation_failed.meaning: The downloaded Playwright browser does not run or misses libraries.
browser_validation_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

browser_validation_unavailable.meaning: The Playwright browser's system libraries could not be checked.
browser_validation_unavailable.fix: Run `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it persists, reinstall the browser by removing `~/.local/share/aicoding/browser-cache/mcp-playwright` and retrying.

browser_version_probe_failed.meaning: The Playwright browser was installed but did not report a version.
browser_version_probe_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

build_failed.meaning: Building the tool from source failed.
build_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

ci_selection_unavailable.meaning: No CI-qualified commit could be selected (GitHub unreachable or no green build yet).
ci_selection_unavailable.fix: Check network access to the download source, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`. Details are in `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

claude_consumers_incompatible.meaning: The fleet check for the shared `~/.claude` failed, so Claude MCP registrations are frozen on every container.
claude_consumers_incompatible.fix: Clear the fleet check first: see "Fleet proof" above, stop idle containers and sync the ones missing tools, then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

claude_version_unavailable.meaning: The Claude CLI did not report its version.

codex_sidecar_missing.meaning: The staged Codex package lacks its code-mode host binary.
codex_sidecar_missing.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

codex_superpowers_link_user_owned.meaning: `~/.codex` has a superpowers link you created, so sync leaves it alone.
codex_superpowers_link_user_owned.fix: Remove the link if you want the managed one, then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

committed_release_invalid.meaning: The release failed validation after it was committed.
committed_release_invalid.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

controller_wrapper_failed.meaning: The kanban MCP launcher could not be made bytecode-free.
controller_wrapper_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

current.meaning: Already at the target version; nothing to do.

entrypoint_invalid.meaning: The npm package declares an unsafe or missing command entry point.
entrypoint_invalid.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

exact_mcp_cli_unavailable.meaning: The exact Playwright MCP release has no CLI, so its browser cannot be installed.
exact_mcp_cli_unavailable.fix: Run `aicoding-auto-update --once` to reinstall the Playwright MCP.

exact_mcp_release_unavailable.meaning: No active exact Playwright MCP release was found.

exact_package_not_staged.meaning: An exact MCP package is not installed and verified yet, so registration and config wait for it.
exact_package_not_staged.fix: Fix that package's own blocker (its `mcp-*` entry), then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

existing_release_invalid.meaning: A release for this version already exists on disk but is damaged.
existing_release_invalid.fix: Remove the damaged copy under `~/.local/share/aicoding/versions/` only if you know it is unused, then retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

frogmouth_install_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

frozen_sync_failed.meaning: Installing the kanban MCP dependencies from its lockfile failed.

go_install_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

installer_download_failed.fix: Check network access to the download source, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`. Details are in `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

lifecycle_scripts_required.meaning: The npm package needs install scripts, which the updater refuses to run.
lifecycle_scripts_required.fix: Nothing to fix locally; the pinned version stays until a release without install scripts is available.

managed_adapter_unavailable.meaning: The pinned dvw source has no unattended install entry point.
managed_adapter_unavailable.fix: Update dvw by hand with `dvw update`, or wait for a dvw release that supports unattended installs.

managed_config_apply_failed.meaning: Writing a managed config file failed.
managed_config_apply_failed.fix: Run `aicoding-sync --yes` and read its output. `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log` has the background run.

managed_config_conflict.meaning: A managed config file was changed locally and also changed in the blueprint.
managed_config_conflict.fix: Run `aicoding-sync` interactively to review and merge the conflict.

managed_install_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

manifest_write_failed.meaning: The deploy manifest could not be written, so the sync result was not saved.
manifest_write_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

mcp_exact_version_staging_unavailable.meaning: The config needs the exact MCP packages (context7, playwright, kanban) and at least one is not installed, verified or fleet-compatible.
mcp_exact_version_staging_unavailable.fix: Fix the `mcp-*` and `mcp-registration-claude-*` blockers doctor lists first, then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

network_disabled.meaning: Network access is switched off for this run (`AICODINGSETUP_SKIP_NETWORK=1`).
network_disabled.fix: Run `aicoding-auto-update --once` from a normal shell with network access.

node_runtime_incompatible.meaning: The installed Node.js is older than the package requires.
node_runtime_incompatible.fix: Update Node.js (in a container: rebuild it on the current devbox image), then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

offline_exact_package_not_ready.meaning: Network is off and the exact MCP package is not installed yet.

offline_verified.meaning: Network is off, but the installed package was checked and is valid.

package_inventory_unavailable.meaning: The npm package's install scripts could not be inspected.
package_inventory_unavailable.fix: Check network access to the download source, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`. Details are in `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

partial_config_blocked.meaning: Some managed config files were held back because a tool they depend on is not ready.
partial_config_blocked.fix: See the `config-*` entries for the reason per tool.

partial_provision_failure.meaning: One or more provisioning steps failed.
partial_provision_failure.fix: Run `aicoding-sync --yes` and read its output. `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log` has the background run.

pinned_revision_invalid.meaning: The kanban MCP pin file in the blueprint is missing or not a commit SHA.

playwright_system_libs_unavailable.meaning: Chromium needs system libraries that are not installed.
playwright_system_libs_unavailable.fix: Run `sudo npx playwright install-deps chromium`, or on a devbox rebuild on the current image.

preparation_deferred.meaning: Provisioning waited for another component (see the other blockers).
preparation_deferred.fix: Fix the other blockers listed; this clears on the next sync.

python_runtime_unavailable.meaning: `python3` is missing, so the Cursor updater cannot run.

reconciliation_verified.meaning: The managed config matches the blueprint.

registration_conflict.meaning: A Claude MCP registration with this name exists and was not created by aicoding, so sync leaves it alone.
registration_conflict.fix: Inspect it with `claude mcp get <name>`. Remove it with `claude mcp remove -s user <name>` if you want the managed one, then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

registration_migrated.meaning: The Claude MCP registration was moved to the managed launcher.

registration_migration_failed.meaning: Replacing the Claude MCP registration failed; the old one was restored.

registration_not_selected.meaning: This MCP is not registered in Claude, and sync only updates registrations that exist.
registration_not_selected.fix: Nothing is wrong unless you want the server. For kanban, install its launcher (`aicoding-auto-update --once`); for others run `claude mcp add` or enable the plugin.

registration_recovery_cleanup_failed.meaning: The backup of the old Claude MCP registration could not be removed.
registration_recovery_cleanup_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

registration_recovery_write_failed.meaning: Sync could not save a backup of the old Claude MCP registration, so it left it alone.
registration_recovery_write_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

registration_remove_failed.meaning: The old Claude MCP registration could not be removed.
registration_remove_failed.fix: Run `claude mcp remove -s user <name>` by hand, then `aicoding-sync --yes`.

registration_rollback_cleanup_failed.meaning: The failed new Claude MCP registration could not be removed.
registration_rollback_cleanup_failed.fix: Check `claude mcp list` and remove the broken entry with `claude mcp remove -s user <name>`, then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

registration_rollback_restore_failed.meaning: The old Claude MCP registration could not be restored after a failed change. A backup is in `~/.local/state/aicoding/registration-recovery/`.
registration_rollback_restore_failed.fix: Re-add the server from that backup with `claude mcp add`, then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

registration_verified.meaning: The Claude MCP registration points at the managed launcher.

release_commit_failed.meaning: The staged release could not be committed or failed validation afterwards.
release_commit_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

relocatable_venv_failed.meaning: Creating the kanban MCP Python environment failed (often a root-owned `~/.cache/uv`).
relocatable_venv_failed.fix: Check `~/.local/state/aicoding/diagnostics/mcp-kanban-uv.log`. If uv reports a permission error, run `sudo chown -R "$USER" ~/.cache/uv`, then `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

runtime_compatibility_unavailable.meaning: The managed file could not be checked against the installed tool.

shared_registration_busy.meaning: Another process held the lock on the shared Claude settings.
shared_registration_busy.fix: Usually clears on the next pass. Otherwise run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

shared_registration_consumers_incompatib.meaning: Not every container sharing `~/.claude` has a compatible version of this MCP, so its registration is frozen.
shared_registration_consumers_incompatib.fix: Clear the fleet check first: see "Fleet proof" above, stop idle containers and sync the ones missing tools, then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

source_cleanup_failed.meaning: The downloaded source could not be removed after staging.
source_cleanup_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

source_stage_failed.meaning: Fetching the pinned source commit from GitHub failed.
source_stage_failed.fix: Check network access to the download source, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`. Details are in `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

stable_launcher_missing.meaning: The managed launcher in `~/.local/bin` is missing, so the Claude MCP registration cannot point at it.
stable_launcher_missing.fix: Run `aicoding-auto-update --once` to reinstall the package, then `aicoding-sync --yes`.

stage_cleanup_failed.meaning: A leftover staging directory or log could not be removed.
stage_cleanup_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

stage_commit_failed.meaning: The staged release could not be committed into place.
stage_commit_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

stage_copy_failed.meaning: Files could not be copied into the staging directory.
stage_copy_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

stage_install_failed.meaning: Installing the package into the staging directory failed.
stage_install_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

stage_integrity_write_failed.meaning: The integrity record for the staged release could not be written.
stage_integrity_write_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

stage_metadata_write_failed.meaning: The package metadata for the stage could not be written.
stage_metadata_write_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

stage_prepare_failed.meaning: The staging directory could not be created.
stage_prepare_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

staged_controller_invalid.meaning: The staged kanban MCP launcher does not start correctly.
staged_controller_invalid.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

staged_metadata_mismatch.meaning: The staged npm package does not match the expected name, version or lockfile.
staged_metadata_mismatch.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

staged_updater_unavailable.meaning: The staged updater library could not be loaded, so exact MCP packages were not prepared.

staged_validation_failed.meaning: The staged release did not pass its own checks.
staged_validation_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

staged_version_mismatch.meaning: The staged binary reports a different version than the target.
staged_version_mismatch.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

sudo_unavailable.meaning: Passwordless `sudo` is not available, so system packages cannot be installed in the background.
sudo_unavailable.fix: Run `aicoding-install` interactively to install them, or allow `sudo -n`.

system_provision_blocked.meaning: System provisioning is waiting on something outside its control.

system_provision_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

target_version_unavailable.meaning: The latest release version could not be looked up.
target_version_unavailable.fix: Check network access to the download source, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`. Details are in `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

tests_failed.meaning: The tool's own test suite failed on the pinned commit, so it was not installed.
tests_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

tmux_build_failed.meaning: Building the pinned tmux from source failed.
tmux_build_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

unsupported_platform.meaning: This CPU or OS has no Cursor release.
unsupported_platform.fix: Nothing to do on this machine; Cursor stays unmanaged here.

update_not_verified.meaning: A tool's update result was damaged or unreadable, so it counts as not verified.
update_not_verified.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

uv_install_failed.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

verified.meaning: The installed version was checked and matches the target.

wrapper_chmod_failed.meaning: The Playwright MCP wrapper script could not be made executable.
wrapper_chmod_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

wrapper_prepare_failed.meaning: The directory for the Playwright MCP wrapper could not be created.
wrapper_prepare_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

wrapper_write_failed.meaning: The Playwright MCP wrapper script could not be written.
wrapper_write_failed.fix: Check free disk space and that `~/.local/share/aicoding` is writable by you, then run `aicoding-auto-update --once`.

*_not_installed.meaning: The tool is not installed, so its managed config was not deployed.
*_not_installed.fix: Install the tool if you use it (then run `aicoding-sync --yes`); otherwise ignore this.

*_update_not_verified.meaning: The tool's last update was not verified, so config that depends on it waits.
*_update_not_verified.fix: Run `aicoding-auto-update --once` so the tool update is verified, and fix that tool's own blocker if doctor lists one. Then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

*_shared_consumers_incompatible.meaning: The fleet check for this tool's shared config folder failed, so its config is frozen on every container.
*_shared_consumers_incompatible.fix: Clear the fleet check first: see "Fleet proof" above, stop idle containers and sync the ones missing tools, then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

*_config_probe_failed.meaning: The tool did not respond to a quick check, so its config was not changed.
*_config_probe_failed.fix: Check that the tool starts (for example `<tool> --version`), then run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

*_shared_config_busy.meaning: Another container held the lock on this shared config folder.
*_shared_config_busy.fix: Usually clears on the next pass. Otherwise run `aicoding-sync --yes`.

*_runtime_unavailable.meaning: A runtime this component needs (go, npm, uv, python3) is missing.

manual_rebuild_required_*.meaning: A system dependency is missing inside the container and cannot be installed in the background.
manual_rebuild_required_*.fix: Rebuild the container on the current devbox image (`dvw` rebuild).

*_timeout.meaning: A system provisioning step ran out of time.
*_timeout.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.

verification_failed:*.meaning: System provisioning finished but the listed tools still look missing or outdated.
verification_failed:*.fix: Retry with `aicoding-auto-update --once`. If it fails again, read `~/.local/state/aicoding/auto-update/worker.log`.
